mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressures that typically lead to tighter monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPI YoY growth exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month signals a weakening labor market, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE rises by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in housing starts (HOUST) below 1.2 million units signals a weakening demand in the housing market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST drops below 1.2 million units.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) over three consecutive months signals a supply-side contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO declines for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) YoY growth is below 2%, this combination signals a tightening monetary policy with controlled inflation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: controlled inflation with tight monetary policy
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5% and CPIAUCSL YoY < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a month signals a strong labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real final sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where RSAFS increases for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is rising and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 3%, this combination signals a supply-side expansion with accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: supply-side expansion with accommodative monetary policy
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where INDPRO is rising and FEDFUNDS < 3%.
